text: めずらしい　ポケモンも　あつめてるって

structure.jp: めずらしい　ポケモンも　あつめてるって
structure.en: I hear he collects rare Pokémon too

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と for passing on what someone said; left at the end of a sentence it means 'I hear'. あつめてるって = 'I hear he's collecting them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something a person keeps doing; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual talk. あつめてる = 'is collecting'.
